_what: The Mishneh Torah container children, copied VERBATIM out of the live Sefaria ToC probe. This is the pin test_v4_2_map_children_are_copied_verbatim_from_the_probe compares scripts/discovery_v4_2_sources.json against.
_why_this_file_exists: The test used to read the probe directly from discovery_builds/, which is gitignored (.gitignore:265) and therefore absent on a fresh CI checkout -- so the ubuntu job died with FileNotFoundError and took the fail-fast windows job with it. Skipping when the probe is missing was rejected: it would make the pin vacuously green on the only machine that runs it. Extracting the 3.9 KB the assertion actually consumes keeps the pin real and tracked.
_regenerate: python _tmp/extract_mt_probe_fixture.py  (re-run only when the probe itself is re-run against Sefaria)
